nodes.label: .fallowrc.json
nodes.summary: Fallow (dead-code analyzer) configuration. Defines entry points (src/index.*, src/main.*), sets duplicate minimum occurrences to 3, enables unused-dependencies warnings, and suppresses exports from several Svelte components (AccessorySelectModal, GuildModal, WeaponPartModal, RaceModal, DidYouMean, ModalSearchHeader, TagFilter) and constants file.

nodes.label: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Agent context document for the voxlblade-builder project. Describes the project as a web-based damage calculator for Roblox game 'Voxel Blade'. Documents the tech stack (Svelte 5, Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Vitest, ESLint, Prettier, pnpm), project structure, development workflow commands, AI agent interaction guidelines, file operations, testing procedures, and security policies.

nodes.label: README.md
nodes.summary: Project README based on Svelte + TS + Vite template. Covers recommended IDE setup (VS Code + Svelte extension), explains why this uses plain Vite over SvelteKit, discusses TypeScript configuration choices (global.d.ts vs compilerOptions.types, allowJs, checkJs), and notes on HMR state preservation.

nodes.label: fallow-output.json
nodes.summary: Fallow v2.102.0 dead-code analysis report. Found 28 issues: 1 unused file (svelte.config.js), 23 unused exports across data modules (Boost.ts, Runebasedmg.ts, defensivePerks.ts, draconicColorEffects.ts, raceEffects.ts, weaponConditionalBoosts.ts, etc.), 2 unused types, and 2 duplicate exports. Entry points: 4 total (1 default index, 3 plugin).

nodes.label: fallow-security.json
nodes.summary: Fallow v2.102.0 security analysis report. Identifies low-severity tainted-sink findings: dangerous-html (CWE-79) via template.innerHTML in DidYouMean.svelte:22, SuggestDrop.svelte:21, App.svelte:1319; dynamic-regex (CWE-1333) via RegExp in App.svelte:253. All findings are reachable from entry but not from untrusted sources, non-cross-boundary.

nodes.label: tsconfig.app.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript config for the application source code. Extends @tsconfig/svelte, targets ES2023, uses ESNext modules, includes svelte and vite/client types, enables allowJs/checkJs, noEmit mode. Includes src/**/*.ts, src/**/*.js, src/**/*.svelte files.

nodes.label: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: Root TypeScript configuration. Simply extends tsconfig.app.json, serving as the default tsconfig for IDE and tooling.

nodes.label: tsconfig.node.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript config for Node.js build tooling (vite.config.ts). Targets ES2023, uses ESNext modules with bundler resolution, node types, strict linting (noUnusedLocals, noUnusedParameters, noFallthroughCasesInSwitch), verbatimModuleSyntax, erasableSyntaxOnly. Includes only vite.config.ts.

nodes.label: vercel.json
nodes.summary: Vercel deployment configuration. Uses npm run build, outputs to dist/, framework: vite. Sets cache headers: immutable 1-year for /assets/*, must-revalidate for /sw.js and /index.html.
